responsibilities: Design, develop, and optimize scalable data solutions using Snowflake as the strategic enterprise data platform.
Build and maintain end-to-end data pipelines integrating SAP, enterprise applications, APIs, and external data sources.
Develop trusted, well-governed data products that support Accounting, Finance, and business stakeholders globally.
Design and maintain data models, semantic layers, and governed datasets for reporting, analytics, and AI applications.
Partner with Finance and Accounting teams to translate business requirements into sustainable, scalable technical solutions.
Develop analytical applications and dashboards using Streamlit, Python, Snowflake, and related technologies.
Utilize SQL, Python, Alteryx, and KNIME to automate data preparation, reconciliation, validation, and transformation processes.
Ensure high standards of data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation across the data landscape.
Support the development of AI-ready datasets and data products for advanced analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled business solutions.
Leverage Snowflake Cortex AI, CoCo, and emerging AI capabilities to accelerate business insights and productivity.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvement through data-driven insights.
Promote best practices in data engineering, analytics engineering, AI enablement, and modern data management.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure high standards of data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation across the data landscape
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Trusted, governed, reconciled data dominates, with only 'accelerate business insights' on the speed side.
evidence.domain_risk: Develop trusted, well-governed data products that support Accounting, Finance
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The data feeds accounting and finance processes and automates 'reconciliation, validation', which is financial-reporting exposure.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Analysts; Automation Specialists; business process experts; Finance; Accounting
evidence.data_team_maturity: you will help establish the trusted data foundations required for intelligent automation
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Snowflake is already the 'strategic enterprise data platform' while the AI-ready foundations are still being established, which fits a growing function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Utilize SQL, Python, Alteryx, and KNIME to automate data preparation, reconciliation, validation, and transformation processes
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Several bullets name tools and uses (Snowflake Cortex AI, Alteryx, KNIME, Streamlit), while others are generic ('Collaborate with cross-functional teams').
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with Finance and Accounting teams
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is finance and accounting, as part of 'AI-powered Finance processes'.
evidence.autonomy_level: Support the development of AI-ready datasets

evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate builds AI-ready datasets and governed models for AI applications, and also uses Snowflake Cortex AI, so enabler wins the tie.
